pages.lesson:
LESSON: PROTOCOLS IN SANATAN DHARMA CIRCUMBULATION

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Religious Practices
Topic 4.1: Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why are protocols important in religious practices?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the protocols of religious practices observed in a Sanatan/Hindu Mandir
2. model the mandatory religious etiquette for self-efficacy

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe the protocols of religious practices observed in a Sanatan/Hindu Mandir
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the protocols of religious practices observed in a Sanatan/Hindu Mandir. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. model the mandatory religious etiquette for self-efficacy
   In simple words: practise until you can model the mandatory religious etiquette for self-efficacy. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation in the examples.
2. Explain Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation.
4. Show that you can: describe the protocols of religious practices observed in a Sanatan/Hindu Mandir

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Invite resource person to give a talk on the mandatory protocols of Why are protocols important in religious practices? 15 the religious practices where learners record and take notes,
2. Self-efficacy: The learner enhances self-awareness and planning skills when engaging in roleplaying the mandatory religious practices in groups.
3. The learner can relate to the skills of role playing the mandatory religious practices to the skills of role playing learnt in Creative Arts & Sports.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe the protocols of religious practices observed in a Sanatan/Hindu Mandir
2. model the mandatory religious etiquette for self-efficacy

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
